periods.time: Night before the final Daien strike and following morning

name.zh: 刀华集结九州电网作战
name.en: Toka rallies the Kyushu power-grid operation

periods.location: Miyazaki emergency center; Kyushu power grid; Central Substation in Fukuoka/Asakura area
periods.summary: Toka proposes defeating Daien by restoring Kyushu's damaged high-voltage power network and sending all available electricity to Central Substation, where she will absorb it as a lightning user. Kaieda presents the plan to Itsuki, who initially rejects using civilians but authorizes it after testing Toka's resolve and learning Tokyo's crisis will drag on. Civilian engineers, laborers, self-defense forces, knights, and shelters work through the blizzard to repair lines, operate plants, protect teams, and preserve people until the grid reaches operation threshold.
periods.cause: Kurono cannot return in time; Tendo's Red Lotus Hell will kill vulnerable refugees before evacuation finishes.
periods.process: Toka publicly asks everyone to fight with her. Workers repair the 500 kV and 220 kV lines, power plants prepare extreme operation, Kanata shields crews, self-defense units clear routes, and Kaieda coordinates via military radio. Toka explains that she cannot defeat Tendo alone but can receive everyone's entrusted power.
periods.outcome: The grid reaches over seventy-five percent restoration and all major plants/substations prepare a thirty-second extreme transmission to Central Substation. Toka receives the electricity through Narukami, breaking her death-chain vision with the collective power.
periods.significance: Embodies the volume's thesis: instead of seeking solitary Awakening, Toka defeats fate by trusting ordinary people's combined strength.
